Class Projectile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.projectiles.Projectile
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
LargeCannonShot, LargeMeteor, SmallCannonShot, SmallMeteor
public abstract class Projectile extends Object implements Serializable
Abstract class representing a generic projectile fired during gameplay. Each projectile travels in a specific direction and may damage a tile on the player's ship.
